newsitem.title: CHINA: China warns oil industry could run in red in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China warns oil industry could run in red in 1997.

text.p: China's oil industry could start running in the red in 1997 as output remains flat while production costs rise, the official China Daily said on Saturday.
Big oil producing cities such as Daqing should start to find other businesses to protect their economies against the eventual drying up of their oil wells, the newspaper warned.
The oil output of many such cities had leveled off or even declined while production costs kept rising, it said.
"Oil cities must transfer part of their finances and materials to cultivate new substitute industries while oil production remains abundant," it said.

Oil production areas should form trans-regional industry groups and the central government should grant more favourable financial policies to help such areas achieve sustainable growth, it said but gave no further details.
